blocks.translation:
• This product is for ages 15 and up. Do not give it to children under 15.
• This product contains small parts. Keep it away from young children to prevent accidental swallowing. There is a risk of choking.
• Do not use this product near the ear. Accidental use may damage hearing.
• Do not put fingers or other objects into moving parts. They may get pinched and cause injury.
• This product contains electronic components; people with pacemakers should take care.
• If you use batteries incorrectly they can overheat, rupture, or leak. Follow the precautions below.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert the batteries with the correct +/− (polarity).
• Always turn the power off and remove the batteries after playing. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit batteries, charge them, disassemble them, heat them, or put them in fire.
• If battery fluid gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a doctor. If it contacts skin or clothing, wash it with water.
• When disposing of the product or batteries, follow your local municipality's waste disposal instructions.

blocks.translation:
• This product contains precision electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it where it will become very hot or very cold. Throw away plastic packaging immediately after opening.
• Do not place this product on resin sofas, seats, tiles or similar surfaces. Color may transfer if it stays in contact for a long time.
• Do not pull or bend movable parts or attachment parts forcefully in unnatural directions.
• Some voice lines have different intonation or may be hard to hear because of the product's characteristics; please understand this.
